subject: Heat map status: first results + cost risk
body:
Hi Alina,

Status: heat maps are done for the first two classifiers. Clear signal — test error is flat for low-frequency basis vectors but spikes above 30% for a band of high-frequency perturbations on the smaller model; the larger model is robust across most of the spectrum but has a narrow mid-frequency weakness we did not expect.

Cost risk: a full heat map means one clean-vs-corrupted evaluation per Fourier basis vector, comparing the tensor_list layer outputs each time, so a 224x224 input grid is tens of thousands of forward passes per model. Right now that is about 40 GPU-hours per model even with Milan's batched evaluation. If the flagship list grows past four models we blow the July timeline.

Freya
